summary: The registrant, Nektar Therapeutics, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 3,532,609 shares of common stock at $92.00 per share, representing a 6.3% discount to the last sale price of $98.16. Underwriters include Jefferies, TD Cowen, Piper Sandler, and Citigroup, with a 30-day over-allotment option for 529,891 additional shares. This is an ordinary equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard underwriting is noted. This filing is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situations angle.
